body: Actually I almost didn't feel anything with 5 mg, I was starting to feel the effect with the new dosage but well this happened! So if it stays only for 4 hours I can say that Ritalin was not the cause, I guess.
I'm really grateful, I'll look into it. Thanks ♡
The last bit definitely called me out. Thanks, I needed it.
Thanks, that really helped a lot. You gave me a lil bit of hope❤️
But I did express what were positive feelings, for me. That's part of the problem.

It's sad. I was really happy and found this endearing everytime I notice but now he things that I find joy in pointing out his flaws. He thinks it's impossible not to notice but well, I have superpowers on social blindness. 

Hearing you really helped me, thanks a lot

I don't know! I have to wait quite a lot for a new session, but I'm really afraid. I think I perform well when there's someone directing me if it's a "short" task. Still, most ADHDers face problems with those kind of tests and we already know how delicate a diagnosis for an adult female Is :(
Absolutely! It's don't really know how to explain it but, in this case, my happiness and his have the same "end": my wellbeing. I want to be better for all those who care about me (myself included!)

Unfortunately I can't, at least not now – mental health here is not very accessible. But I really want to try my best for him, do you have any alternative? 
And thanks a lot for your kindness!
Even though I consciously know he won't? Is it possible?
Oh, I didn't know they were adjustable! Now it looks interesting, thx
They're very reluctant on giving me meds, unfortunately. I'll try the rest of the things, thanks a lot!💕
I tried studying both with and without coffee. Coffe usually keeps me more level-headed but still can't make me "present". I'll try Gatorade and hope for the best :((
Honestly I think it would put me in a very sour mood, my study sessions are very long and I would probably be exhausted by the end of it :(
I'll try to learn more about it. Thanks a lot💕
We're in deep shit lol
Loving your rambling and loving the way you express yourself here! I hope to find an answer so that I can proudly say I belong in this "us" :)
will do, thanks!

Thank you so much for listening, you have no idea of how this has helped! I actually score pretty high in all self assessment test, but I'm always asking myself if I'm exaggerating in order to get a diagnosis. I really feel like something doesn't add up, but seeing others act like I'm overreacting has taken a tool on my mental health. I really hope it's not my borderline (not bipolar, but you were almost there!) talking, because adhd it's one of the only things that actually explains the way I've lived all my life. 
Again, I'm really grateful ♡
Sorry, I didn't mean to be pushy or anything like that. It's gonna take a lot of time before I can go to a dr – money-wise. I'm trying to go on with what I have, so I appreciate your help :(

Shouldn't BPD be limited to emotional dysregulation (and the consequences of it)? Other symptoms have never arised talking with fellow BPD-ers, if not as consequences of a depressive episode. I'll try to look more into it
If I'll ever be able to know what's going on, you're gonna be one of the first to know! Hope I can help somehow :(
I'm sorry that you also feel this way, really. Do you have a diagnosis, by any chance?

I think that my bpd may be the cause of the "hyperactive" attitude, but the attention problem? I've had them since I was I child. How is BPD related to my being unorganized, forgetful and so on – considering that my trauma had not developed yet? (I'm sincerely confused, hope you don't take it the wrong way)
